definitions.gloss: flowering plants; flowers and grasses; herbaceous flowers
definitions.explanation: A general term for herbaceous plants that produce flowers, as opposed to trees or shrubs. Often used when talking about gardens, fields, or nature in general.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{草花|くさばな}を{植|う}える。
examples.english: To plant flowers in the garden.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{野原|のはら}に{草花|くさばな}が{咲|さ}き{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When spring comes, wildflowers begin to bloom in the fields.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{毎日|まいにち}{草花|くさばな}の{手入|てい}れをするのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: My grandfather enjoys tending to his flowers every day.

notes:
A compound of {草|くさ} (grass/plants) and {花|はな} (flowers). Emphasizes the combination of greenery and blossoms in a natural or garden setting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草花|くさばな}を{育|そだ}てる: to grow flowers
- {草花|くさばな}を{植|う}える: to plant flowers
- {野|の}の{草花|くさばな}: wildflowers
- {草花|くさばな}の{手入|てい}れ: tending flowers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {花|はな}: flower — general term for any flower, including on trees
- {植物|しょくぶつ}: plant — broader scientific/general term for all plants
- {花卉|かき}: flowering plants — formal/technical term used in horticulture
- {雑草|ざっそう}: weeds — unwanted plants growing in unwanted places
